title: Differential maps in the quotient conormal sequence (Stacks Tag 00RU)
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $\mathfrak a\subseteq B$ be an ideal, and put $C=B/\mathfrak a$, an $A$-algebra via $A\to B\to C$; let $\Omega$ and $\mathrm d$ be the Kähler differentials and universal derivations of [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Then there are well-defined maps $$\mathfrak a/\mathfrak a^2\xrightarrow{\ \delta\ }C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}\xrightarrow{\ w\ }\Omega_{C/A}$$ with $\delta(a\bmod\mathfrak a^2)=1\otimes\mathrm da$ for $a\in\mathfrak a$ ($\delta$ $B$-linear) and $w(c\otimes\mathrm db)=c\,\mathrm d\bar b$ for $c\in C$, $b\in B$ ($w$ $C$-linear), where $\bar b$ is the class of $b$ in $C$; the sequence is exact at $C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}$ (the kernel of $w$ is the image of $\delta$) and $w$ is surjective.
